newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Investor says no talks to Roche.
newsitem.headline: Investor says no talks to Roche.

text.p: Swedish investment company Investor AB said on Wednesday it has not been in contact with Swiss drug company Roche about a possible bid for Swedish drug company Astra AB.
Investor spokesman Nils Ingvar Lundin confirmed that Investor's managing director Claes Dahlback had said this to a seminar on Wednesday.
"He said the same thing he has earlier...we have not heard anything from (Roche)," Lundin told Reuters.

Rumours about a possible takeover have driven up Astra's share price sharply in recent days. On December 9, the share soared 13 crowns to 345 crowns, but then fell back six crowns on December 10 to 339 crowns as rumors faded.
According to Lundin, Dahlback said that he did not think Roche was planning a takeover of Astra because Investor, a major owner in Astra, had not been contacted.
